privacy_policy_intro: This policy explains how FastTourney processes personal data when you use the service.
privacy_policy_controller_body: The controller is Jose Antonio García Yáñez. For privacy or rights requests: joseantoniogarciay@gmail.com.
privacy_policy_data_body: We process your email, username, language, password protected as a hash, session identifiers and, if you choose Google, that account identifier. We also process tournament, team, result, follow and administrator data that you create or receive, as well as suggestions you choose to send us.
privacy_policy_purposes_body: We use data to create and verify an account, provide access, manage leagues and results, keep the service secure and handle requests. The main basis is performance of the requested service; security relies on legitimate interests and applicable legal obligations.
privacy_policy_sharing_body: We do not sell data or show personalised advertising. Google is involved if you choose that sign-in method. A Google mailbox receives suggestions, and Resend delivers those email alerts. Cloudflare may process technical connection data while protecting the public connection. To keep the service reliable, PostHog may process minimum technical crash and failure data in the EU region; we do not send credentials, tokens, form values or HTTP bodies.
privacy_policy_retention_body: An account and its private suggestions are kept while active. Unverified accounts are deleted under the service technical cycle. When deletion is requested, it remains pending for 30 days and is then deleted automatically; retained results no longer show the deleted author. An email copy of a suggestion is deleted when it is no longer needed for review. Minimum terms-acceptance evidence is restricted for five years after deletion.
privacy_policy_public_body: Your username and published league content, such as teams, results and standings, may be visible to other people. Do not include sensitive data in those fields.
privacy_policy_minors_body: The service is not intended for people under 14. Do not create an account if you are under 14.
privacy_policy_rights_body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction or portability by writing to the controller. You may also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency if you believe processing infringes your rights.
privacy_policy_changes_body: We will update this policy before applying material changes to processing. The date above shows its latest review.

volleyball_best_of_five_help: Best of five sets: first four to 25 points, fifth to 15, always winning by two.
volleyball_score_help: The first team to win three sets wins. The first four sets end at 25 points and the fifth at 15, with a two-point lead (e.g. 26–24 or 16–14). Leave unplayed sets empty.
volleyball_withdraw_team_description: {name} withdraws from the league. All their matches become 0–3 losses, with three 0–25 sets.
volleyball_standings_columns: P: played; W: won; L: lost; Pts: league points. SW/SL: sets won/lost; SR: SW ÷ SL. RF/RA: rally points for/against across all sets; RR: RF ÷ RA.
volleyball_standings_rule_points: Winning 3–0 or 3–1: 3 points; winning 3–2: 2; losing 2–3: 1; losing 0–3 or 1–3: 0.
volleyball_standings_rule_order: Order: most wins, most league points, highest set ratio, then highest rally-point ratio. Head-to-head adds no further criterion.
volleyball_standings_rule_ratios: Ratios display up to three decimal places, but ranking uses exact values. A positive value divided by zero displays as ∞ and exceeds any finite ratio; 0 ÷ 0 counts as 0.
volleyball_standings_withdrawal: Withdrawal: all of the team’s matches, including played ones, become 0–3 losses with three 0–25 sets and count in all statistics. Earlier history is retained; a withdrawn team cannot qualify for the knockout stage.
goal_standings_match_rule: Scores record goals. League matches may end tied; a knockout tie requires a decisive penalty shootout.
basketball_standings_match_rule: The final score includes any necessary overtime: it must be decisive and has no shootout.
goal_standings_columns: P: played; W: won; D: drawn; L: lost; Pts: league points. GF: goals for; GA: goals against; GD: GF minus GA.
basketball_standings_columns: P: played; W: won; D: drawn (always 0); L: lost; Pts: league points. PF: points scored; PA: points conceded; PD: PF minus PA.
standings_rules_mini_table: The mini-table uses only matches among all tied teams: points earned, scoring difference, then scoring for. Overall criteria use all matches.
standings_rules_shared: If all criteria remain equal, teams share their position. When a league ends, teams sharing first place are joint champions.
football_standings_withdrawal: Withdrawal turns all the team’s matches into 0–3 losses, including played matches. These results count in the table and earlier history is retained.
basketball_standings_withdrawal: Withdrawal turns all the team’s matches into 0–20 losses, including played matches, with no point for losing. They count in the table and earlier history is retained.
handball_standings_withdrawal: Withdrawal turns all the team’s matches into 0–10 losses, including played matches. These results count in the table and earlier history is retained.
standings_rules_qualification: In mixed format, withdrawn teams are excluded. If a tie crosses the qualification cutoff, tiebreak matches are played before the knockout stage starts. Cross-group seeding compares position and sport criteria; registration order only stabilizes equal values.
standings_rules_tiebreak: The tiebreak stage ranks by wins, scoring difference, then scoring for. Each match needs a winner using this sport’s tie resolution. If the cutoff remains tied, another cycle is played.
volleyball_standings_tiebreak: The tiebreak stage keeps best-of-five matches and the same volleyball ranking by wins, points and ratios. If the cutoff remains tied, another cycle is played.
standings_rules_elimination: In knockout play, each match winner advances; no league points are awarded.
standings_rules_racket_only: Racket sports only offer direct knockout in this version.
handball_standings_match_rule: Scores record goals. League matches may end tied; a knockout tie after overtime requires a decisive seven-metre shootout.
badminton_best_of_three_help: Best of 3 games. The selected scoring stays the same throughout the tournament.
badminton_score_help_21: Each game ends at 21 points with a two-point lead, capped at 30. At 29–29, the first to 30 wins. Leave unplayed games empty.
badminton_score_help_15: Each game ends at 15 points with a two-point lead, capped at 21. At 20–20, the first to 21 wins. Leave unplayed games empty.
result_incident_partial_help: Leave it empty or keep the sets or games played, including the last unfinished one.
result_incident_effect: The incident affects only this match. Partial scores are not used for standings.
result_incident_partial_invalid: Complete both scores or leave the partial score empty. Only the last set or game may be unfinished.
